text:
zoe: quick design review from user testing: the p95 mini-map scrubber is great, but users missed the delta to their service baseline. also the sampling slider sits visually close to the legend and feels like part of it. recording + notes: https://staging.redwood.com/rec/mini-map-delta :mag:
matt: can confirm. feature requests: 1) show a compact delta badge in the p95 tooltip (e.g., +12%) with color-coded direction, 2) decouple sampling control visually from legend (a small separator), 3) increase mini-map handle hit area.
maya: a11y flags: delta badge needs text alternative like 'p95 increased 12 percent vs baseline'. currently color is the only signal. also legend contrast ramp fails on dark mode for low density buckets. propose patterned fills or stronger stops at low alpha.
jon: engineering notes: patterned fills on canvas heatmap are doable but add draw cost. alternative: keep canvas but draw a subtle diagonal hatch only for cells under contrast threshold; toggle that by accessibility settings. also we'll add a sr-only label for delta badge.
sam: screen reader semantics: the p95 tooltip should read 'p95 234 milliseconds, up 12 percent from baseline'. For delta badge use aria-hidden=true and provide an adjacent sr-only span for screen readers. For the sampling slider ensure aria-valuetext = 'Sampling rate: 5 percent'.
a11y-bot: checklist generated: ["delta badge sr-only label", "legend contrast >= 4.5:1 or patterned fills", "mini-map handle hit area >= 44px", "sampling control separated from legend and tabbable", "tooltip aria-live polite for delta updates"]. link: https://staging.redwood.com/a11y/minimap-174210
zoe: UX microcopy: instead of 'Rate' use 'Sampling rate'. delta badge copy: '+12% vs baseline' and a tooltip explanation 'Baseline: average p95 for last 7 days'. keep it short.
matt: CSS snippet to keep sampling visually separate 
```css
.legend-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }
.sampling-sep { margin-left: 12px; border-left: 1px solid var(--muted-border); padding-left: 12px; }
```
maya: keyboard focus bug found: when users keyboard into mini-map then open sampling menu, focus lands inside a modal-like container but tab sequence loops incorrectly. suspect focus trap applied globally. make sampling menu not trap focus; allow returning to previous focusable. add aria-expanded on menu button and restore focus on close.
jon: will fix. also perf note: drawing patterned hatches per-cell at 60hz on large maps is expensive. do hatch drawing during idle time and cache a pattern canvas to reuse. will add will-change: transform to the overlay to keep compositing.
sam: for delta announcements avoid spamming SR users when data updates rapidly. throttle aria-live updates to once per 500ms and only announce significant changes (+/- >1%).
zoe: mobile layout question: where to put the sampling slider on narrow screens? options: bottom sheet, compact inline control under the mini-map, or hide behind kebab. I prefer bottom sheet on first reveal because it's discoverable and gives room for a larger slider.
matt: bottom sheet is fine if quick to open. ensure it's dismissible with swipe and esc. also add a small persistent icon inline that opens the sheet so users know it's available.
maya: micro-interaction: when delta badge flips sign, animate the badge color and icon (chevron up/down) with reduced motion respected. also provide an accessible keyboard shortcut (Alt+D) to toggle delta comparison in the tooltip. add aria-keyshortcuts="Alt+D" on the compare control.
jon: i'll add an e2e: open dashboard, focus mini-map, scrub to set p95, press Alt+D, assert tooltip shows delta and sr-only text present, open sampling sheet with keyboard and set to 5% and ensure focus restores to the sampling button after close.
sam: i'll run VO and NVDA passes once PR lands. also will provide exact strings for sr-only spans.
a11y-bot: updated checklist: ["throttle aria-live updates to 500ms","sr-only delta copy provided","sampling sheet focus restore","patterned hatches fallback","handle hit area >= 44px on touch"]. link: https://staging.redwood.com/a11y/minimap-174210/updated
zoe: owners: jon (focus + perf patterns), sam (SR strings + throttling), maya (contrast + keyboard flow), matt (mobile sheet + discoverability). i'll file parent ticket and attach mock GIFs. final acceptance: delta badge present and accessible, sampling control visually separated and keyboardable, no jank on large heatmaps, mobile sampling accessible via bottom sheet and dedicated icon. closing thread, thanks! :sparkles:
